# NIST

> The National Institute of Standards and Technology develops measurement standards, reference materials, and research to advance innovation across engineering, science, and technology sectors.

NIST is a federal agency that provides critical infrastructure for U.S. scientific and industrial competitiveness through standards development, measurement science, and applied research across diverse technical domains. The organization maintains facilities in Boulder and Gaithersburg and operates specialized laboratories including the Communications Technology Laboratory and Center for Nanoscale Science and Technology.

## Key Topics

- Standards Development
- Measurement Science
- Standard Reference Materials (SRM)
- Standard Reference Data
- Artificial Intelligence
- Advanced Communications (5G/NextG)
- Quantum Technology
- Biopharmaceuticals
- Construction Safety
- Infrastructure Resilience
- Sensor Calibration
- Reference Materials
- Measurement Standards
- Critical Infrastructure
- Biomedical Devices

## Core Research & Standards

- [Artificial Intelligence](https://www.nist.gov/artificial-intelligence): NIST AI governance, Risk Management Framework, standards development
- [Advanced Communications](https://www.nist.gov/advanced-communications): NIST advanced communications research in 5G, NextG, spectrum sharing
- [Electronics](https://www.nist.gov/electronics): NIST electronics standards, semiconductors, quantum technology research
- [Chemistry](https://www.nist.gov/chemistry): NIST chemistry standards, measurement methods, reference databases
- [Health](https://www.nist.gov/health): NIST biomedical measurement standards for medical devices and diagnostics
- [Bioscience](https://www.nist.gov/bioscience): NIST bioscience measurement standards for biotechnology and biopharmaceuticals
- [Energy](https://www.nist.gov/energy): NIST energy measurement science, testing standards, efficiency certification

## Infrastructure & Safety

- [Infrastructure](https://www.nist.gov/infrastructure): NIST infrastructure research in smart grids, critical infrastructure, resilience
- [Buildings & Construction](https://www.nist.gov/buildings-construction): NIST building safety, construction standards, disaster prevention research
- [Fire](https://www.nist.gov/fire): NIST fire research, safety testing, wildfire prevention, disaster response
- [Forensic Science](https://www.nist.gov/forensic-science): NIST forensic science standards, DNA analysis, drug detection research

## Environmental Science

- [Environment](https://www.nist.gov/environment): NIST environmental science measurements and standards for air, water, soil

## Products & Services

- [Shop NIST](https://shop.nist.gov): NIST e-commerce store for Standard Reference Materials and Data

## Support & Information

- [Contact NIST](https://www.nist.gov/contact): NIST contact information, staff directory, and location finder
